name: Nightowl
source:
A group of high school friends reunite over a chat room and try to relive the good times of when they were all together, but can their friendship endure the lost time?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/nightowl]itch.io[/url]]

Entry for Ludum Dare 37.
translation:
一群高中时代的朋友，在聊天室里重聚，试图重温曾经相伴的美好时光。然而，他们的友情，能否经受住岁月与疏离的考验？

[摘自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/nightowl]itch.io[/url]]

Ludum Dare 37参赛作品。
